indicator.name: Mortalidad materna
indicator.description: Muertes maternas estimadas por cada 100.000 nacidos vivos.
indicator.null_policy: No se interpola ni se convierte en cero.
indicator.methodology: Estimación modelizada interinstitucional; la interfaz no representa sus intervalos de incertidumbre.

official_metadata.name: Maternal mortality ratio (modeled estimate, per 100,000 live births)
official_metadata.source_note: Maternal mortality ratio is the number of women who die from pregnancy-related causes while pregnant or within 42 days of pregnancy termination per 100,000 live births. The data are estimated with a regression model using information on the proportion of maternal deaths among non-AIDS deaths in women ages 15-49, fertility, birth attendants, and GDP measured using purchasing power parities (PPPs).

transformations: clasificación explícita de países y agregados
